title: Preserve WebView panel scroll during refresh
summary: Preserve scroll positions for WebView scrollable panels, tables, detail blocks, and document scroll across refresh-driven re-renders.
reason: Automatic refresh can rebuild table/detail DOM while the operator is reading a scrolled panel, causing the visible panel to snap back to the top.
behavior_before: Refresh-driven renders could replace or rewrite scrollable DOM contents without restoring the operator's scroll position.
behavior_after: Full refresh and Completed current-output refresh capture scroll positions immediately before render and restore them after the render settles, including replaced nodes with stable IDs.
